title: Mixed Event — Musical Twilight Parade — Episode4 A Place Where I Can Smile

meta.Episode: Episode4 — A Place Where I Can Smile
meta.Event Outline: Shiho has been scouted by a band that's ready to make its big debut, giving her a lot to think about. Then, Saki invites her on a visit to Phoenix Wonderland. Meanwhile, Tsukasa and the rest of WxS make their own preparations, eager to host them!

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Next is the super fun, exciting and psychedelic area known as Dreamland☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa...! I used to LOVE this place as a kid!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Where you're supposed to be in a dream world or something, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. Home of the Fluffy☆Trampoline Dome that lets you feel like you're bouncing high above the clouds.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And Phenny's Dreamy Night, a cart ride that takes you through Phenny Penguin's fantastical dreams!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I remember you really loved the Trampoline Dome, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! The feeling of jumping around all those fluffy clouds was the best!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. It's been one of your favorites since you were little. We'd always go to the Trampoline Dome, but you kept begging us to go back in for seconds or even thirds.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'd convince you to give up, but then you wouldn't stop sulking after that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The only way to cheer you up was to buy you a fruit parfait from the park restaurant. It happened so much, it's still fresh in my head.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Don't bring up old stories like that, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I can totally see that happening.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe! That's really nice!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: After all, Phoenix Wonderland is a place that puts a smile on everyone's face☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Like Tsukasa and Saki, people have been coming here since they were little, and again as high school students or grown-ups. They get to enjoy the park in different ways every time!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I want this place to be where everyone can smile and have fun no matter how old they are!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah! I completely agree!
PXL will always have a special place in my heart!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A special place where my childhood memories and the fun times I had with Tsukasa and everyone from Leo/need are♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, you're right.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Everyone has a lot of fond memories of this place...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I used to perform here occasionally, but I don't think I ever came here with someone else just to have fun.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that sense, I guess you could say the fondest memories I have of this place are the shows we've been performing as a troupe.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, it's the same for me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Then... Why don't we make some nice memories together?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Since we're already here, we can see different attractions and have fun together, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, together... Including you, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh... O-Okay.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Alright☆
In order to make many good memories together...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I propose that we visit as many attractions in Dreamland as possible!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Count me in!
Where should we start?
No, it has to be the Trampoline Dome!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Jumping on a trampoline at our age might be kind of embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Aww, no way...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We might end up scaring the children playing inside if so many of us went in at once. Let's try something else this time, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I guess...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Nene! Hey, Nene! Now's the time for you to try to start a conversation with everyone!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-That's easier said than done...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
K-Kusanagi!
Do you have any suggestions?
Any ride or attractions you're interested in?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh?! Um, I...
I think...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (You can do it, Nene!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How about that one?
Phenny's Nightmare!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's a haunted house, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! It's a little dark and creepy just like it's name suggests!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I-Is it that scary...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, not at all!
The attraction is designed to be family-friendly.
It has comical props to amuse people of all ages!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then that should be fine, I think...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: How can a haunted house be any fun if it isn't scary?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I-It's still super fun! This is a haunted house that puts a big smile on everyone's faces☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it really isn't a haunted house if it makes people smile or laugh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I must say, a family-friendly haunted house that makes people smile is intriguing to say the least. Maybe it can give me ideas for our future shows.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm curious too!
Let's go! Let's go♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Then shall we go in?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Fine by me. I'll come along.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, let's go inside☆

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: K-Kusanagi, can I ask you...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line: Nene! Hurry up or we'll leave you behind!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, okay...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ar-Are... Are you coming...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Y-Yes!
Let's go join them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay...
